# opnsense_dnsmasq_tag (Resource)

Dnsmasq DHCP tags (Services > Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP > DHCP tags). Hosts and ranges set tags on clients; options and boot entries apply only to clients with a matching tag. Reference a tag by `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dnsmasq_tag" "pxe" {
  tag = "pxe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String) Tag name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_dnsmasq_tag.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
